items.summary: Handoff: keep SearchWoot private and continue the existing consolidated evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix. All four launch-readiness tasks remain open; external outreach, public exposure, and rights-dependent monetization remain blocked pending counsel and owner review.

Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream source rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Evidence: API access is documented, but rights to store, transform, cache, display, alert on, or monetize returned data are not established; current public terms point against the proposed use. Fleet compliance remains a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics and revenue attribution are yellow; aggregate revenue remains unattributed. Continue only existing bounded work preserving consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, rights, and platform-policy boundaries.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for official API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task has complete evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, alert identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.
